title: ARC Raiders x CORSAIR: Official gear collection and exclusive in-game rewards
body:
# Never fumble the extraction

Has this ever happened to you? Your bag is full of loot. The elevator is opening. You're almost home free.

Then something with too many legs crests the ridge. You reach for the dodge roll, your thumb slips off the stick, and just like that, it's over.

The next thing you know, you're waking up in Speranza, down one kit, left only with the thought of what might have been.

First rule of raiding: never let your fingers leave the controls.

ARC Raiders has partnered with CORSAIR, SCUF Gaming, and Elgato to produce an official gear collection designed for Topside. Every item carries Raider-inspired styling, and every purchase unlocks exclusive in-game rewards.

# What's In the Collection

The lineup includes controllers for PlayStation, Xbox, and PC, along with a keyboard, a mouse, a headset, two mouse pads, and a Stream Deck. Every item features ARC Raiders-inspired design. Here are the specifics:

* **SCUF Gaming** – Omega (PS5 and PC), Valor Pro Wireless and Wired (Xbox and PC), Valor Pro Faceplate Kit, and Nemesis Pro 8K (coming soon, PC). These are customizable gaming controllers with rear paddles that keep your thumbs on the sticks, plus triggers that respond the instant you act.

* **CORSAIR** – CLIPPER PRO MINI 60 keyboard, SABRE v2 PRO Wireless MG mouse, HS80 RGB WIRELESS headset, and MM cloth mouse pads in Large and 2XL sizes. The 2XL pad doubles as a map. Where that map leads is something you'll need the rest of the gear to find out.

* **Elgato** – Stream Deck MK.2 and a matching faceplate, made for Raiders who stream, multitask, and manage their full setup mid-raid.

Supplies are limited. Scrappy is not part of the collection, but he gives it his approval.

# How to Get Your in-Game Rewards

Beginning October 29, every qualifying purchase from the official collection at corsair.com includes a unique single-use code that unlocks exclusive in-game items. These codes can be redeemed on PlayStation, Xbox, or PC through the Embark ID Portal, which is accessible from the ARC Raiders section of the Embark ID site.

Preorders begin on October 29, timed to coincide with ARC Raiders' first anniversary, though exact shipping dates will differ by product. Frozen Trail is now live, the Rust Belt has gained a new frontier, and the gear to match it all is here.

For full details, product availability, and code redemption, check the ARC Raiders section of the CORSAIR website.
